_readme: Clash of Clans glossary for coctools-slangs.html. One entry per section (id = the filter chip), each with its terms. Add a term: add {term, def} to the right section; abbr is an optional short form shown as a pill.

terms.def: Friendly Challenge — a war simulation between clanmates without affecting loot or trophies.
War term for the opposing base that shares the same number as yours in the war lineup.
The act of intentionally leaving certain troops and/or spells unused during an attack.
Placing a troop to lure friendly or enemy troops toward a desired location, e.g. directing your Warden to the right spot.
A base or player with every building, troop, spell, and hero at the highest possible level for their Town Hall.
A player who upgraded their Town Hall before maxing troops, heroes, or buildings at the previous level.
Balloons deployed as a sacrifice to trigger Seeking Air Mines and clear the path safely for the main air army.
Combined army of Hog Riders and Miners used together for wide ground coverage.
Combined army of Dragons and Dragon Riders, typically paired with Rage spells.
Lava Hounds tank air defenses at the front while Balloons follow behind to deal damage.
Abbreviation for the Flame Flinger siege machine.
The large Skeleton subtroop spawned by the Super Witch during battle.
Archer Queen deployed alongside Healers to destroy key defenses deep inside the base.
Archer Queen uses Healers to clear the outside perimeter of a base strictly for funneling purposes.
Combines Invisibility Spells with the Royal Champion to let her charge deep into the core undetected.
Grand Warden uses his Fireball equipment to destroy clustered defenses, protected by Healers and spells.
Destroying edge buildings to channel troops toward the core, e.g. Queen Charge on one side and Siege Barracks on the other.
High-HP troops sent into the center relying heavily on the Grand Warden's ability to keep them alive.
Uses a Log Launcher to open a path and send heroes deep into the base.
Deploying large numbers of troops quickly with minimal funneling — effective against open spread-out bases.
Skeleton or Bat Spells combined with Invisibility to destroy key defenses, typically the Clan Castle.
A Battle Blimp carries Super Wizards into the core, supported by well-timed Invisibility spells.
Warden's Fireball equipment destroys clustered defenses, supported by Healers and spells.
Destroying buildings from outside their defense range — typically Archers placed barely out of reach.
A defense fully surrounded by walls with open space on all sides, forcing attackers through multiple wall layers.
The area or defenses at the far end of a base that attacking troops reach last.
Non-defensive buildings (Barracks, Collectors) placed on the outer edge to drain attacker deploy time.
The center of a base or the tightest cluster of high-value defenses.
Multiple Hidden Teslas clustered together that pop up simultaneously to overwhelm troops.
A lone Hidden Tesla placed in a corner to drain attack time and cause time-fail situations.
A defensive layout built to minimize trophy loss — protecting resources is not the concern.
A layout focused on keeping resource storages locked inside heavily defended compartments.
Balances war and farming — protects resources while maintaining a strong defensive core.
A layout designed to be as hard as possible to three-star; loot protection is irrelevant.
